correctness.rationale: From the twenty-vertex, thirty-edge GP(10,2) graph and 60 distinct induced forbidden triples, an independent DP enumerated all 2^20 vertex subsets and identified exactly 63143 faces, with f-vector (1,20,190,1080,3985,9772,15870,16640,10770,4000,750,60,5). The specified 20-pivot greedy toggle has 31570 nonempty matching pairs; the full nonempty Hasse DAG passes an acyclicity topological sort of all 63142 nodes. Only one 0-cell and one 6-cell survive. Forman theory gives a CW model with a 6-cell attached to a point, hence S6 integrally. The high-dimensional nonpure facets do not invalidate the Morse collapse.
